description: This file defines an enumeration and utility functions related to retrieving and handling current location data using CoreLocation. It provides a method to resolve the current location with optional caching and timeout support, as well as mapping custom accuracy levels to CLLocation accuracy constants.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Asynchronously resolves the current location, optionally using a cached value if it is recent enough, and applying a timeout to the location request.

methods.name: accuracyValue
methods.description: Maps a custom OpenClawLocationAccuracy level to a specific CLLocationAccuracy constant.
